title: AI and the Market for Signals
abstract: arXiv:2609.17752v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Early-career work both signals a worker's ability and builds long-run skills. We introduce an AI industry into a career signaling model. The industry sells tokens, which workers convert into output indistinguishable from their own. We compare three regimes: no token trade, purchases only, and open trade with side sales. With no token trade, market learns every type, signalling incentives create a rat race and workers work above the full information level. With token purchases only, lower types buy output but the market still learns every type. Buying by lower types raises the signal higher types must post, so the high types can work harder than before AI. Buyers work less with AI, even below the full-information level. With side sales and abundant AI, the signal no longer depends on effort and every type under-invests in skill. Workers gain from token trade only when welfare improves, never the reverse, and the difference is the AI indus

translated_abstract: 早期职业生涯的工作既传递劳动者能力的信号，又能积累长期技能。我们在职业信号传递模型中引入一个AI产业，该产业出售代币，劳动者可将其转换为与自身产出无法区分的产出。我们比较了三种制度：禁止代币交易、仅允许购买、以及允许转售的开放交易。在禁止代币交易时，市场能够识别每种类型，信号激励造成恶性竞争，劳动者的工作强度高于完全信息水平。在仅允许购买时，低类型劳动者购买AI产出，但市场仍能识别每种类型；低类型的购买抬高了高类型必须传递的信号门槛，因此高类型可能比AI出现前工作得更努力；而购买者在有AI时工作更少，甚至低于完全信息水平。在允许转售且AI充裕的情况下，信号不再依赖于努力程度，所有类型都在技能上投资不足。劳动者仅在社会福利改善时才能从代币交易中获益，反之则不可能，两者的差额即为AI产业的利润。
tldr: 本文将AI代币产业引入职业信号传递模型，揭示出三种交易制度的不同后果——禁止交易时激励过度、仅允许购买时高类型更累而购买者更闲、开放转售且AI充裕时信号彻底失效并导致所有类型技能投资不足，且劳动者只有在社会福利改善时才能从代币交易中获益。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an AI token industry into a career signaling model, showing that while banning trade causes rat-race overwork and purchase-only regimes make high types work harder, open token trade with abundant AI destroys the informativeness of signals and induces skill under-investment by all types, with workers benefiting from token trade only when welfare improves.
